title: Ozi Autonomous Orchestration — Work queue + auto-chain = continuous delivery
summary: Design for Ozi as autonomous work orchestrator: maintains prioritized work queue (teachings → inbound → signals → local), marks items ready vs needs_refinement, executes with approval, chains jobs with minimal context, captures UAT + implementation notes in track. Enables: users build queue, Ozi executes, clear burndown, continuous delivery.
description: Session 73: User described vision for work queue management. Instead of 'Ozi what should I work on?', Ozi maintains queue. Two modes: (1) Interactive 'Work the job queue' / 'Review refinements', (2) Auto-chain: approve once, Ozi chains through jobs (implement → minimal closeout → load next), minimal context (~20k tokens), track captures UAT + implementation. Queue prioritizes: teaching files first (framework upgrades) → inbound lugs (hub deliveries) → signals (learnings) → local work (project items). Lug creation auto-enrolls in queue.
design_pillars: Queue discipline: Prioritized, visible, chainable work list
Minimal context: Each job loads only WAI + named lug + prev track (~20k vs 46k full wakeup)
Ready vs refinement: Auto-discover readiness, present refinements for user review
Autonomous execution: Approve once, chain through queue until completion or stop
Accountability: Track + UAT recording creates audit trail + learning
User controls depth: Can work queue interactively or delegate to Ozi auto-mode
enabling_practices: User builds lug queue. Ozi works through it.
Lug creation is enrollment in work queue
Priority order built into framework (teachings first)
Track file is continuous execution log
impact_on_framework: Ozi becomes autonomous work dispatcher, not task suggester
Clear burndown visibility (queue state in WAI-State)
Minimal context overhead (20k vs 46k per job)
Track becomes execution audit log, not just context bridge
user_value: Build the queue once. Ozi executes. No babysitting.
See exactly what's queued and in what order (priority-driven)
Approve auto-mode: 'Go!' and Ozi works while you do something else
UAT in track means implemention is documented and testable
Context stays lean: each job knows what it's doing
next_action: Implement epic-ozi-work-queue-orchestration-v1. This is largest epic yet (10-15 steps). Needs: queue schema, priority logic, minimal context loader, auto-chain orchestrator, track extensions, closeout integration.
learning: Autonomous work execution scales. Framework should assume Ozi can work without supervision. Give it a queue, it executes. Give it approval, it chains. This is the path to true 'AI as responsible partner' — not just suggesting work, but tracking + executing it accountably.
routing_notes: Highest-impact signal yet (10). Transforms how all spokes interact with Ozi. Teaching for entire framework ecosystem.
